result.nodeCatalog: get_node_catalog returns the real Add menu, limits/availability and validated example apply_edits operations. Studio and MCP share these factories.
result.projectBatch: batch_projects prepares independent projects, edits and optional exports. dryRun writes nothing; real runs return a background job. Inspect result.ok and each item, even when the job completes. Transactions are per file, not across files.
result.qa: analyze_project hashes straight RGBA at each requested frame (all export frames by default), rerenders in reverse order for parity, and optionally compares a root-scoped saved baseline. Peak activity is not a game hit marker.

coordinates.position: layer anchor in canvas pixels, before animated motion
coordinates.points: layer-local offsets from the animated anchor
coordinates.geometry: width/radius/handle offsets and masks are layer-local; worldPoints and pixel bounds are canvas coordinates
coordinates.time: project seconds; keyframe t is normalized within each layer
coordinates.layerOrder: bottom to top; the last layer is in front

agentWorkflow.observe: observe_project returns an annotated image, scene positions, isolated pixel bounds, timing, picks and revision. Try view=storyboard before editing.
agentWorkflow.edit: apply_edits performs 1..64 atomic operations with one backup. Preview the same edits through observe_project with file/revision/edits; drafts do not write.
agentWorkflow.visionFallback: images[].uri can be read through resources/read or saved by save_preview for a host image viewer. If no image viewer is available, use structured scene metadata; do not claim to have seen an image.

result.creative: inspect_creative lists macro controls, variants and valid layer binding targets. edit_creative edits modifiers, controls, variants and timing. save_component and insert_component reuse selected layers across projects. start_variant_export queues a batch of 1..8 variants.
result.stage: Optional separate camera scene: get_stage and get_schema stage/stage_placement, apply_edits configure_stage/place_stage_layer, render_preview and analyze_project view=stage, export options.view=stage. Same source layer frames on ground/upright/billboard planes; camera-baked output, not volumetric XYZ particles.
result.imageProcessing: Local PNG optimization needs no browser. Palette, scale, block and alpha reductions are lossy; default PNG recompression preserves decoded RGBA.
result.editing: get_blueprint discovers control outputs, typed layer inputs, connections and ordered modifiers. apply_edits connect_control/disconnect_control routes parameters; edit_path_point maintains Bezier anchors and handles. Merge base fields directly when appropriate; curves are {t,value,ease} arrays, colors are {t,color} stops.
